title: Agents Feedback Record
description: A repository-local record of sanitized workflow feedback for future agents and maintainers.

id.description: Stable record identifier and filename prefix using a UTC date, time including seconds, and short slug.

summary.description: One-sentence scan line describing the repository feedback.

observation.description: What happened, stated without assuming the cause.

paths.description: Repository-relative files or directories affected by the observation. Use a single dot for repository-wide feedback and forward slashes on every platform.

updated.description: UTC timestamp for the latest meaningful change or repeated observation.

safety.description: Content review state. Shared public repositories commit only public records; internal requires repository policy support.

redactions.description: Short descriptions of content removed or generalized during safety review.

area.description: Stable lowercase repository area used for filtering, such as setup, tests, docs, tooling, or packages/api.

kind.description: Feedback category. Use unknown during initial capture when classification is not clear.

severity.description: Expected impact on future work. Use unknown during initial capture when impact is not assessed.

evidence.description: Sanitized support for the observation. Summarize output instead of pasting raw logs or private content.

impact.description: How the observation affects efficiency, correctness, safety, setup, or verification.

environment.description: Generalized machine context that is relevant to reproducing the observation without identifying a person or device.

os.description: Operating system family or version without a hostname or user path.

shell.description: Shell family or version relevant to the observation.

architecture.description: Machine architecture relevant to the observation.

tools.description: Relevant tool names mapped to generalized version values.

occurrences.description: Number of materially separate confirmations. Omit for the first occurrence.

hypothesis.description: Possible cause, clearly separated from the observed facts.

confidence.description: Confidence in the hypothesis, not in the observed event.

reproduction.description: Minimal steps another agent or maintainer can use to reproduce the observation.

actions.description: Candidate improvements considered before triage selects one.

id.description: Stable action identifier within this record.

action.description: Concrete improvement that could address the observation.

reason.description: Why this action could address the observation.

risk.description: Estimated change risk or blast radius.

decision.description: Explicit triage decision. Omit while the record remains untriaged in the new folder.

reviewer.description: Person, role, or explicitly delegated agent responsible for the decision.

action.description: Selected action identifier when the decision is accepted.

links.description: Related record, issue, pull request, discussion, or external planning references.

plan.description: Small execution plan for the accepted action.

completed.description: UTC completion timestamp. Include only while the record is in the completed folder.
